description: Trace the redirects of a URL on four versions (http and https, with and without www.), hop by hop up to 10, and report loops, chains, temporary redirects, https-to-http downgrades, meta refreshes, a final page that does not answer 200, and versions that end on different pages. No KinetixSEO account needed. A site checked in the last 24 hours gets that stored result. Free: spends no credits.

url.description: The URL to check: a domain (example.com) checks its home page; a full URL (example.com/old-page) checks that page, path and query kept.
